result.brief: 提出基于高分辨率视频扩散的多视角4D一致增强框架，结合布局感知位置编码与潜空间频率损失，从稀疏低分辨率采集重建沉浸式体积视频。
result.reason: Uses multi-view video diffusion with layout-aware positional embeddings and latent frequency loss to enhance sparse captures for 4D-consistent volumetric video; contributes video-generation-side representation/training technique.
